1.web: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
1.asv: Praise ye Jehovah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, andpraise is comely.

2.web: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
2.asv: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem; He gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

3.web: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
3.asv: He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.

4.web: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
4.asv: He counteth the number of the stars; He calleth them all by their names.

5.web: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
5.asv: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.

6.web: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
6.asv: Jehovah upholdeth the meek: He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.

7.web: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
7.asv: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving; Sing praises upon the harp unto our God,

8.web: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
8.asv: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

9.web: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
9.asv: He giveth to the beast his food, Andto the young ravens which cry.

10.web: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
10.asv: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man.

11.web: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
11.asv: Jehovah taketh pleasure in them that fear him, In those that hope in his lovingkindness.

12.web: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
12.asv: Praise Jehovah, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.

13.web: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
13.asv: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.

14.web: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
14.asv: He maketh peace in thy borders; He filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

15.web: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
15.asv: He sendeth out his commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly.

16.web: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
16.asv: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.

17.web: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
17.asv: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: Who can stand before his cold?

18.web: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
18.asv: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: He causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

19.web: He shows his word to Jacob; his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
19.asv: He showeth his word unto Jacob, His statutes and his ordinances unto Israel.

20.web: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
20.asv: He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for his ordinances, they have not known them. Praise ye Jehovah.
